ms.report:
Thank you for taking the time to review our milestone submission.
Report: Final Milestone.
General Aspects to consider:
・- Respect to the Gimbalabs Playground sessions: the third season of Gimbalabs Playground ended on June 25th, 2024 (see last session's date on https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVMnYs6P8=/?moveToWidget=3458764563494604015&cot=14). The fourth season recently started, on Sept 24th, 2024. As a result, since the last milestone report (M5), only 2 Gimbalabs Playground sessions have been produced (check the miro board above) + 1 special edition on Aug 20, 2024.
・

・- However, the number of sessions to be delivered for this milestone goes beyond the minimum required (12 sessions), achieving successfully the objective of the milestone.
・

・- Although in many cases, the recordings of the sessions do not reflect a total time of 90 minutes, the sessions are 90 minutes each. This condition can be easily verified by attending the live sessions (access links at https://gimbalabs.com/calendar). Reason: In this type of community exercise, a certain level of privacy must be preserved, in which people interact with each other outside the public eye, in this case, the video recordings.
